title: Authorize Timeclock CLI
intro: Connect your terminal to this workspace.
permissions: The CLI can view and change time, projects, timesheets, and reports according to your account permissions. It cannot change your password or sign-in methods. Authorization lasts up to 30 days; signing out of the CLI ends it sooner.
confirmBrowser: Approve only if you just started signing in from your own terminal.
confirmDevice: Check that this code matches your terminal. Never approve a code someone else sent you.
returnToTerminal: Return to your terminal to continue.
failed: Authorization failed. Start sign-in again from your terminal.
unavailable: CLI sign-in is unavailable here. Check the server address in your terminal and try again.
changeWorkspace: To authorize another workspace, switch workspaces in Timeclock and reload this page.
